privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: myKPT is used by students under 18, so we collect as little as possible.
privacy.collect1: Your email, so you can sign in.
privacy.collect2: A first name or nickname, your grade and your subjects.
privacy.collect3: Your progress, notes, flashcards and chats with the tutor.
privacy.not1: No date of birth, phone number, address or school name.
privacy.not2: No advertising trackers. We never sell data.
privacy.ai1: Your messages are sent to our AI provider to write a reply. They are not used to train AI models.
privacy.ai2: Messages are checked for safety. If something looks harmful, the tutor points you to someone who can help.
privacy.control1: Delete any chat from the chat history. Ask a parent, guardian or teacher to contact us to delete your account.
privacy.payment1: A parent or guardian pays through Paddle, our reseller. Paddle keeps the payer's name, email and card details; we never see card numbers.
privacy.payment2: When a parent gives permission we keep their name and the date, as a record of consent.

safety.support:
It sounds like you're going through something really hard, and I'm glad you said something. You don't have to deal with this alone. Please talk to an adult you trust today, like a parent, guardian, teacher or your school counsellor.

In Mauritius you can call **113** at any time (Child Development Unit hotline, free, 24 hours) if someone is hurting you or you don't feel safe. If you are in danger or might hurt yourself, call **999** (police) or **114** (SAMU ambulance) now.

There is a list of people who can help on the **Get help** page in your profile menu. Whenever you're ready, I'm here to help with your school work.
safety.cantHelp: I can't help with that. Let's get back to your learning: what subject or question can I help you with?
safety.manipulation: I'm your study tutor, and the way I work can't be changed from the chat. Let's get back to learning: what subject or question can I help you with?

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms cover using {app} and paying for a plan. A parent or guardian agrees to them for a student under 18.
terms.use1: {app} helps students in Grades 7 to 13 learn and revise the Mauritian curriculum.
terms.use2: Use it for your own learning. Don't share your account, try to break the app, or ask the tutor for harmful content.
terms.use3: We may suspend an account that breaks these rules.
terms.ai1: Lessons and tutor replies are written by AI. They can contain mistakes, so check important facts with your teacher or textbook.
terms.ai2: {app} supports learning; it does not replace school, teachers or official exam guidance.
terms.plans1: Every new account gets {days} days of full access for free.
terms.plans2: After the trial, lessons stay open. The tutor, revision material and exam marking need a paid plan.
terms.plans3: Plans are monthly or yearly and renew automatically until cancelled.
terms.payment1: Our online reseller Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for all orders. Paddle handles payment, tax, receipts and refunds.
terms.payment2: Cancel any time from the link in Paddle's receipt email. The plan keeps working until the end of the period already paid.
terms.payment3: Refunds follow Paddle's buyer terms. Ask through the receipt email if something went wrong.
terms.changes1: If these terms change, we show the new date here. For price changes on an active plan, Paddle tells the payer before the next renewal.

help.title: Get help
help.intro: If something is worrying you, you don't have to deal with it alone. These people can help, for free.
help.urgentTitle: If you are in danger right now
help.childTitle: If someone is hurting you, or you don't feel safe at home or anywhere
help.child: Child Development Unit hotline: free, 24 hours, 7 days a week
help.talk1: A parent, guardian or another adult in your family
help.talk2: A teacher, your form tutor or the school counsellor
help.talk3: Your school's rector or deputy rector
help.tutor1: The tutor is a computer program, not a person. It can't call anyone for you or keep you safe.
help.tutor2: Never share your phone number, address, school or photos of yourself in the chat. The tutor removes contact details it spots.
help.tutor3: If the tutor says something that upsets you or seems wrong, tell a teacher or parent.
